summary: Former tower site on Lookout Mountain, Saguache County, in Rio Grande NF; registered 2009 as US 537 and taken down. No build or staffing dates found.

notes_for_editor: Only status and registration are sourced. Register calls it a tower site; the FFLA Colorado list calls the structure a platform. The FFLA list spells the county 'Sagauche' (typo, not used). A different removed Lookout Mountain (Porphyry Mountain, Pitkin County) appears on the same FFLA list and must not be merged. No build date, design, staffing or fire history found in the two searches allowed; no current site description found. Public access unknown.
